_doc: Real CVE before/after-fix evaluation corpus (Option A). NO third-party code is vendored into this repository; fetch.py reproducibly clones each repo (blobless) and extracts the single changed source file at the exact vulnerable and fixed commit SHAs into _fetched/ (gitignored). The vulnerable commit (= fix commit's parent, unless stated) is the positive; the security-fix commit is the safe twin. Every pair here was VERIFIED by fetching and inspecting the fix diff. This is a tiny, hand-verified corpus for qualitative what-is/ isn't-supported reporting ONLY; NO accuracy is claimed from it.
budget_note: Platform per-file analysis uses num_ctx=8192 (~8k tokens). Files larger than that are truncated by Ollama at call time (not an error); flagged per case as over_context.

cases.detector_note: sink is aiohttp StaticResource path resolution (os.path.normpath/.resolve/relative_to); NOT in our SINKS set, and file exceeds num_ctx -> expect NOT detected (truncation + framework-shaped).
sink is os.path.join on a secure_filename-processed name (upload save path); os.path.join is NOT in our SINKS set, so taint sees no sink; broad may reason about it (file fits context).

fix is a one-line jinja2 Environment -> SandboxedEnvironment import swap; the analyzed file has NO sink and NO user input (the SSTI is elsewhere), so expect NOT detected in EITHER version. Included to document this limitation, not as a fair detection test.

vuln is os.system(f"vd {' '.join(paths)}") with user resource paths -> os.system IS in our SINKS (command_injection); fix uses subprocess.run([...]) argv. Small file, fits context. This case tests real-world detection for a pattern we DO model, isolating detection ability from vocabulary coverage.

not_sourced.ssrf: No verifiable small, permissively-licensed Python SSRF with a MERGED fix commit found via open search this pass (candidates were large repos or open issues without a merged safe-twin commit). Reported as a gap, not padded.
not_sourced.sqli_deser: Not sourced to a verifiable small merged-fix pair this pass; the command_injection control (frictionless) covers one in-vocabulary class. Add sqli/deser from a curated dataset (e.g. CVEfixes) if expanding.
